decision: Reject v40 before native packaging. Aggregate accuracy passed, but the preregistered per-capability and per-route gates failed.
measured_bottleneck: The source bundle contains only 461 coherence and 71 cake-output-realization rows versus 16457 route-4 rows. Uniform capability sampling could fit the search set but did not generalize the rare realization route.
next_evidence_supported_branch: Keep the exact compact architecture and runtime footprint fixed. Train one fresh router from the union of the original v40 search-training partition and the non-overlapping segregated v9 bundle, which contributes 500 coherence and 977 cake-output-realization records. Split v9 by prompt hash so repeated prompt texts cannot cross training and fresh holdout.
